quick_facts.sprint_goal: Admins can compare performance across all stores, reassign users between stores, and configure store details — turning the admin panel into a true multi-tenant control center.

content.tldr: Admin power features: cross-store revenue comparison dashboard, global user management (with store reassignment), store configuration editing, and user password reset flow.

features_committed.title: Multi-store Admin Panel
features_committed.rationale: Admins managing multiple store locations need aggregate visibility and centralized control.
tasks: T089: GET /admin/reports/stores — revenue today + this month per store (admin only)
T090: Admin /admin/dashboard — store comparison table: store name, today revenue, invoice count, active users
T091: Store selector component for admin: switch context to view any store's data
T092: PATCH /stores/:id — edit name, address (taxCode immutable per business rule BR-STORE-03)
T094: PATCH /auth/users/:id/store — reassign user to different store (admin only)
T095: User edit modal in /admin/users: change role + store assignment
T096: POST /auth/users/:id/reset-password — admin-initiated password reset (returns temporary password)
T097: Deactivate user: cascade flush Redis sessions for that userId

also_this_sprint: Add buyer taxCode optional field capture on POS payment modal (for B2B invoices)
Store timezone config (vi-VN, UTC+7 enforced — ensure all date comparisons use store local time)
out_of_scope: Email delivery of reset password link (post-MVP — temp password shown in UI)
Custom roles beyond the 4 defined roles (post-MVP)
prerequisites: Sprint 4: Store UI + User UI base pages complete
Sprint 6: Reporting API complete (reuse for per-store stats)

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 10 planned. Multi-store admin: cross-store dashboard, user reassignment, store edit, password reset.
